name: demo_calculator_tool
description: Add, subtract, multiply or divide two numbers and return the result as a number. Pure and stateless: no side effects, no network, no auth beyond the group's key, no rate limit of its own. Division by zero returns a tool error (isError) with a one-sentence message instead of a value. Use it when an exact arithmetic result matters; for anything beyond one binary operation, chain calls or compute in the model.

var1.description: first operand (left-hand side); any finite number

var2.description: second operand (right-hand side); must be non-zero for divide

func.description: operation to apply as var1 <func> var2
